class.name: gravity_compensation_controller/GravityCompensationController
class.description: Joint-space (KDL-based) gravity compensation for free-drive/hand-guiding. Static gravity torque only, no Coriolis/inertia compensation. Writes 0 torque until enabled via the ~/enable (std_srvs/SetBool) service, then ramps to full torque over a configurable duration. Only meaningful when the hardware plugin's control_mode is "torque" (kp=kd=0).
